strings.تشطيبات الأبواب المخفية في الكويت: دهان: Hidden door finishes in Kuwait: wall paint, veneer or cladding?
strings.إذا حددت طريقة فتح الباب المخفي، يبقى سؤ: If you select the method of opening the hidden door, an important question remains: what is the most suitable finishing for the wall? Paint helps to approximate the color of the door with the wall, and the wooden veneer adds a different character, and the cladding needs a finer coordination of engraving and edges. The choice depends on the door system and the approved sample, not on the name of the material alone.

strings.الباب القابل للطلاء: تقارب اللون يحتاج ع: Paintable door: Color affinity needs sample
strings.في هذا الخيار تكون الضلفة مهيأة لتشطيب د: In this option, the wrap is ready for a compatible paint finish. Companies offer systems and panels for painting, but that doesn’t mean any old door can be stained to become a fully hidden door. The frame, the level of the wrap and the edges remain essential parts of the result.
strings.لا تعتمد رقم اللون وحده. اطلب عينة على س: Do not rely on the color number alone. Ask for a sample on a surface similar to the door, and compare it with a wall sample under the lighting of the place. The difference in gloss or texture of the surface may make the door clearer even if the same color is used. Also explain who is responsible for processing the surface of the door leaf and who performs the final layer, so that the result is part of one agreement.
strings.القشرة الخشبية: اتجاه العروق جزء من التص: Wood veneer: the direction of veins part of the design
strings.القشرة الخشبية تشطيب له مظهر الخشب، وليس: Wood veneer finishing has a wood appearance, and is not a name for the way the door is opened. It can be within door products designed for certain systems. It provides
strings.مستندات مختلفة للأبواب المفصلية والسحاب،: different documents for hinged and sliding doors, illustrating the need to check product compatibility with the system.
strings.إذا الجدار المحيط خشبي الطابع، اطلب توضي: If the surrounding wall is wooden in character, ask to clarify the direction of the veins and arrange the pieces on the backend and fixed parts. See the actual sample instead of the judgment of the screen image, and discuss the shape of the door edge when it is open. The fusion of the facade from the side of the hall does not guarantee that the second side carries the finishing itself.
strings.الكسوة الديكورية: لا تُضاف إلى أي ضلفة م: Decorative cladding: Do not add to any foreground directly
strings.قد ترغب بامتداد كسوة الجدار فوق الباب لي: You may want the wall cladding extension above the door to be part of the configuration. Here you dip the cladding thickness, weight and installation method with the door system specification. Just color compatibility is not enough; the designer needs to make sure that the edges, movement and handle allow for suggested detail without friction.
strings.اطلب رسمة تبين تقسيمات الكسوة وخطوط الفص: Ask for a drawing showing cladding divisions and separation lines at the door. If the pattern is strong, see where the moving part starts and ends. Do not connect a fixed finishing layer across the spacer needed for movement, and do not ask to cancel all breaks against the shape of the image; the operating details are determined by the chosen system.
strings.أربع نقاط لاعتماد التشطيب قبل التصنيع: Four points for adoption of finishing before manufacturing
strings.اسم التشطيب الفعلي ودرجة اللون واللمعة،: Actual finishing name, color score and gloss, with reference sample.
strings.شكل الجهتين والحواف ومكان التقاء الوزرة: The shape of the two sides and edges and the place where the ministry meets the door.
strings.تأكيد ملاءمة التشطيب للضلفة والمفصلات ون: Confirm the suitability of finishing for the fork, hinges and the specified opening system.
strings.طريقة التنظيف وتعليمات العناية المقدمة ل: The method of cleaning and care instructions provided to the tent used.
strings.احتفظ بصورة العينة المعتمدة وتفاصيلها ضم: Keep the image and details of the sample in the project view. If the material changes after adoption, its suitability will be reviewed again before implementation. This step is clearer than simply saying “the same picture” which may not show the lighting, edges or backside.
